verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Hardware reset → register reset values per Table 1.
ENDN register reads 0x87654321 (endianness probe).

CCCR Protected-Write semantics: writes to DBTP / NBTP / CCCR.NISO/BRSE/FDOE/TXP/EFBI/PXHD / GFC / SIDFC / XIDFC / XIDAM / RXF0C / RXBC / RXF1C / RXESC / TXBC / TXESC / TXEFC / TSCC / TOCC / TDCR rejected when CCCR.INIT = 0 OR CCCR.CCE = 0.
Software initialization sequence — full register programming with CCCR.INIT + CCCR.CCE = 1; verify INIT cleared = 0 readback before normal operation.
Hardware initialization Message RAM (write 0x0 to each word) — verify no IR.BEC / IR.BEU due to uninitialized ECC.
Classical CAN DATA FRAME with each DLC value 0..15 (DLC > 8 must still produce 8-byte frame in Classical mode).
CAN FD DATA FRAME with each DLC value 0..15 (DLC 9..15 → 12/16/20/24/32/48/64 bytes).
Bit-rate switch (BRS = 1) in CAN FD: arbitration phase at NBTP rate, data phase at DBTP rate, CRC delimiter back to NBTP.
BRS = 0 in CAN FD: whole frame at NBTP rate.
ESI bit transmission: error-active node → ESI = dominant; error-passive node → ESI = recessive.
ESI bit override: Tx Buffer T0.ESI = 1 force-recessive (regardless of error state) — OR-ed with error-passive flag.
Classical REMOTE FRAME (Tx Buffer T0.RTR = 1, T1.FDF = 0) transmitted per ISO 11898-1:2015.
RTR-on-FD-buffer behavior: T0.RTR = 1 + T1.FDF = 1: M_CAN transmits CLASSICAL remote frame (RTR overrides FDF).
Multi-node bitwise arbitration (2 nodes, 3 nodes, identifier corner cases standard + extended).
Arbitration loss + receiver-switch behavior; per-buffer TXBRP.TRP_n behavior (cleared in DAR mode).
DATA FRAME vs REMOTE FRAME same-ID priority (DATA wins).
Classical CAN CRC computation (X^15 + X^14 + X^10 + X^8 + X^7 + X^4 + X^3 + 1).
CAN FD CRC-17 computation (payload ≤16 B) per ISO 11898-1:2015.
CAN FD CRC-21 computation (payload >16 B).
ISO mode stuff-count + parity protection (CCCR.NISO = 0).
Non-ISO mode (CCCR.NISO = 1) — no stuff-count protection.
ISO-only synthesis (iso_only_g = 1): CCCR.NISO reads 0 + cannot be written to 1.
Bit-stuffing on / off in correct fields (Classical and CAN FD).
STUFF ERROR detection on 6 identical consecutive bits.
FORM ERROR detection on illegal bits in fixed-form fields (Classical and CAN FD).
BIT ERROR detection on transmitted vs monitored mismatch — arbitration phase at sample point; data phase at SSP when TDC enabled.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT ERROR detection on missing dominant ACK.
PROTOCOL EXCEPTION EVENT — FDF = 1 + res = 1 received with CCCR.PXHD = 0 → PSR.PXE + PSR.ACT = 00.
PROTOCOL EXCEPTION HANDLING DISABLED (CCCR.PXHD = 1) — same condition triggers Form Error + error frame.
ACTIVE + PASSIVE ERROR FLAG generation + superposition behavior.
Error counter increment / decrement per ISO 11898-1:2015 Section 12.
Fault confinement transitions: active → passive (count ≥128) → bus-off (TX count = 256) → active recovery (129 × 11 recessive bits after CCCR.INIT clear).
Warning level: PSR.EW = 1 when either counter ≥ 96; IR.EW.
Error Logging Counter (ECR.CEL) — increment + overflow → IR.ELO; reset on read of byte 2.
Restricted Operation Mode (CCCR.ASM = 1): TEC + REC frozen; CEL keeps counting; entered automatically on Tx Handler RAM access failure.
m_can_cok input behavior: 0 → CCCR.ASM forced 1; 1 → ASM returns to written value.
Loop Back Mode — External (TEST.LBCK = 1, MON = 0) — Tx visible on m_can_tx + Rx loopback + ACK errors ignored.
Loop Back Mode — Internal (TEST.LBCK = 1, MON = 1) — m_can_rx disconnected, m_can_tx held recessive.
Bus Monitoring Mode (CCCR.MON = 1): receive valid + remote frames; dominant bits rerouted internally.
Disabled Automatic Retransmission (CCCR.DAR = 1): per-buffer TXBTO + TXBCF behavior on each completion case.
Transmit Pause (CCCR.TXP = 1): verify 2 additional CAN bit times after own successful transmission.
Edge Filtering during Bus Integration (CCCR.EFBI = 1): require 2 consecutive dominant tq for hard sync.
Hard synchronization on SOF.
Resynchronization on subsequent edges within ±NSJW (arbitration) / ±DSJW (data).
Bit timing per-segment programming (NBTP + DBTP min / max values per spec).
DBRP limited to 1..2 when DBTP.TDC = 1.
Transmitter Delay Compensation: enable DBTP.TDC = 1; verify PSR.TDCV updated each FD-BRS frame.
TDC filter window (TDCR.TDCF) — suppression of early dominant edges on m_can_rx.
TDC bound: sum of TDC + TDCR.TDCO ≤ 6 bit times in data phase; ≤ 127 mtq absolute.
OVERLOAD FRAME generation (receiver-internal vs intermission-dominant cause).
Max 2 consecutive OVERLOAD FRAMEs rule.
INTERMISSION = 3 recessive bits enforcement.
Acceptance Filter — all SFT/EFT types (range, dual-ID, classic-bit-mask, disabled).
Acceptance Filter — all SFEC/EFEC actions (000-111).
Acceptance Filter — non-matching frame default action (GFC.ANFS / ANFE / RRFS / RRFE).
Acceptance Filter — XIDAM masking for 29-bit IDs (J1939 mask).
Acceptance Filter — Sync message (SSYNC/ESYNC = 1 + CCCR.UTSU = 1) → m_can_tsrx pulse.
Acceptance Filter — filter event pin generation (SFID2[8:6] / EFID2[8:6]) → m_can_fe[2:0] pulses.
Acceptance Filter — store in dedicated Rx Buffer (SFEC = 111 + SFID2[10:9] = 00).
Debug message handling (SFEC = 111 + SFID2[10:9] = 01/10/11) — verify DMS state machine + m_can_dma_req / m_can_dma_ack hand-off.
Rx FIFO 0 blocking + overwrite modes; watermark; full + lost interrupts.
Rx FIFO 1 blocking + overwrite modes; watermark; DMS state observability.
Dedicated Rx Buffer New Data flag (NDAT1 / NDAT2) handling + IR.DRX.
Tx FIFO (TXBC.TFQM = 0) put-order transmission.
Tx Queue (TXBC.TFQM = 1) lowest-Message-ID transmission.
Mixed Dedicated + FIFO / Mixed Dedicated + Queue.
Tx Cancellation: dedicated + Queue OK; FIFO NOT supported.
Tx Event FIFO write per Tx Buffer T1.EFC = 1; ET = 01 (Tx event) vs ET = 10 (DAR transmission-in-spite-of-cancel).
Tx Event FIFO watermark + full + lost + new-entry interrupts.
Wide Message Markers (CCCR.WMM = 1) → 16-bit MM in Tx Event FIFO replaces TXTS.
External TSU (CCCR.UTSU = 1) — verify pulse outputs + TSC / TXTSP fields in Rx FIFO / Tx Event FIFO.
Internal Timestamp Counter wraparound → IR.TSW.
External Timestamp Counter (TSCC.TSS = 10) — required for CAN FD timestamping.
Timeout Counter: all 4 modes (continuous + Tx Event FIFO + Rx FIFO 0/1).
Sleep / wake-up cycle: full m_can_clkstop_req / CCCR.CSR path + abort path with disturbed bus.
Access to Reserved Address → IR.ARA + m_can_aei_ara pulse.
Message RAM Access Failure → IR.MRAF; Tx Handler failure → CCCR.ASM = 1.
External ECC: m_can_aeim_berr[0] → IR.BEC; m_can_aeim_berr[1] → IR.BEU + CCCR.INIT = 1.
RAM Watchdog (RWD.WDC) → IR.WDI on no-READY response.
Two interrupt lines (m_can_int0 + m_can_int1) routing via ILS + ILE + IE.
30 IR flags W1C semantics (writing 1 clears; writing 0 has no effect).
fields.notes: The M_CAN User's Manual does not include a formal verification plan; categories above are derived from Chapters 2-3 + Section 4.1. Industry-standard CAN-conformance test suites (ISO 16845-1 for Classical, ISO 16845-2 for CAN FD) implement the protocol-level scenarios programmatically. M_CAN-specific register-level + acceptance-filter + Tx/Rx FIFO/Queue scenarios are integrator-verified using directed + constrained-random testbenches.
